description: BLA EVA NON-SKID DECKING SHEET SELF ADHESIVE GREY 850X850MM
categoryDescription: Boat Building Materials from the BLA Australia catalogue.
subCategoryDescription: Marine Construction Board products from the BLA Australia catalogue.
catalogueDescription: Soft textured self-adhesive EVA non-skid protective decking sheet in grey. The sheet is sound absorbing, reduces harmonic vibration and has a self-adhesive backing for easy fitting. Suitable for slippery hatch lids, anchor wells, bow rollers, engine room floors and similar areas. Density: 240 kg/m3. Thickness: 3-3.3 mm. Size: 850 x 850 mm.
